summary: A first home is bought with help from a veterans' benefit.
realLife: About four years after her 1948 marriage, a woman and her husband bought their first and only home in El Paso with help from his G.I. Bill benefits.
sources: Texas State Historical Association Handbook of Texas, Maria Angela Socorro Grijalva Acosta (summarizing a 1982 UTEP oral history): https://www.tshaonline.org/handbook/entries/acosta-maria-angela-socorro-grijalva-lucy
inGame: `event:housing.purchase`. `needs:` a veterans' benefit that enables the purchase.

turns.pulledBy: a gift from a relative on the money record

turns.writesBack: the line says they never bought
